snapshot_note: This audit records the 13 property definitions after the final claims audit corrected two implementation-semantic bleed findings and before regenerated Milestone-7 enrichment. It intentionally stores no property-JSON hash because those records are regenerated; property_id, local path, formula text/status, and immutable frozen-source locators are the comparison keys.

reviewer.note: This is not either of the two required human reviews and is not an ACCEPTED/REJECTED arbitration decision. PASS is only a gate-local evidence result.

status_vocabulary.PASS: Gate-local evidence is closed in the inspected snapshot; this is not acceptance.
status_vocabulary.CANDIDATE: Usable only as an explicitly low-authority, inactive, or provisional candidate.
status_vocabulary.NEEDS_CONTEXT: Normative context, exception scope, event semantics, or formalization is unresolved.
status_vocabulary.NEEDS_BINDING: Exact AP truth, source-to-AP identity, clock-aligned observation, or trace projection is not closed.
status_vocabulary.UNSUPPORTED: The current artifact cannot enter this gate, for example no concrete formula or direct parser incompatibility.

catalog_formula_parse.reason: Mitl.g4 requires &&/||, a modality immediately followed by an interval, integer bounds, and a parenthesized negated atom when it is the operand of G/F; catalog formulas use single &, G_/F_, decimal seconds in two formulas, and unparenthesized !atom.

explicit_translation_build_only.satisfiability: SAT for all eight positive formulas
translation: remove the underscore between modality and interval
scale every interval bound from seconds to integer milliseconds
parenthesize a negated AP used directly under a temporal modality
explicit_translation_build_only.claim_limit: A successful transformed build-only run is not parser validation of the catalog text, semantic-equivalence proof, non-tautology, non-vacuity, trace validation, or conformance.

trace_smoke.clock_limit: TraceParser.cpp accepts unsigned integer time atoms only; a campaign must select and document one integer tick unit and one clock domain.
trace_smoke.finding: A representative finite GCS trace that sets the antecedent and gcs_failsafe_event together at time 0 still ended POSITIVE under the current runner. Under the intended point-valuation reading this appears to be an early-event counterexample, so the trace/finite-word interpretation requires calibrated oracle tests before any verdict is trusted.
trace_smoke.temporary_output: /tmp only; no smoke-test output was persisted in the workspace
